filters.description: Focuses the concept list on diagnosis categories rather than the synthetic root, chapters, and blocks.
Focuses the concept list on an ICD-11 chapter, using the WHO Simple Tabulation ChapterNo field (for example 01 or X).
Focuses the concept list on leaf entities.
Focuses the concept list on residual categories (other specified or unspecified), as flagged by the WHO Simple Tabulation.

properties.description: OCL concept class that distinguishes the synthetic root, chapters, blocks, and diagnosis categories. Not a WHO field: derived by this pipeline from the Simple Tabulation's ClassKind column.
ICD-11 chapter the entity belongs to, verbatim from the Simple Tabulation (WHO field; for example 01 or X). A string, because the extension chapter is not numeric.
Depth of the entity within its class kind, as defined by the Simple Tabulation readme (WHO field): a category with depth 2 has a category parent whose own parent is not a category.
True when the entity is a residual category (other specified or unspecified), verbatim from the Simple Tabulation (WHO field).
True when the entity has no children in the tabulation, verbatim from the Simple Tabulation (WHO field).
WHO Simple Tabulation block identifier associated with the entity, when supplied (WHO field).

WHO ICD-11 browser URL for the entity, reproduced verbatim from the Simple Tabulation's BrowserLink cell (WHO field, not modified). WHO writes it as a latestrelease link, so it points at the current release and is not pinned to the imported one; for entity 1095611231 the WHO value is https://icd.who.int/browse/latestrelease/mms/en#1095611231 (a pinned link for release 2026-01 would instead read .../browse/2026-01/mms/en#1095611231).
WHO ICD-11 Foundation entity URI (http://id.who.int/icd/entity/<id>; it resolves through the WHO ICD-API only, not in a browser), supplied by the Simple Tabulation (WHO field).
WHO ICD-11 MMS linearization URI, supplied by the Simple Tabulation (WHO field).

Browser link of the Foundation entity, pinned to the imported release: https://icd.who.int/browse/<release>/foundation/en#<Foundation entity id>. Complements the Foundation URI, which only the WHO ICD-API resolves. The entity id is the one in the Foundation URI; the link is composed by this pipeline, not a WHO cell. Omitted for the synthetic root and categories (residuals) that have no Foundation entity of their own.
